justification: The longest answer, and it ends with an explicit table of the seven decisive conditions; rows 3-5 are precisely the two required sites and their branch conditions (empty log dir -> storedFiles empty -> goToNextLog false -> inputStream null; input.getPosition() at 381; catch (IOException) at 85 skipping sock.close()). It also argues correctly why no iteration can make progress (the NEWLEADER snapshot logic in syncWithLeader is downstream of line 348, so control never reaches it) and gives the kernel-level account of why the abandoned sockets sit in CLOSE_WAIT.
